text:
sanjay: Nightly eval fail on q4 onboarding run — model 'model-quant-v2' produced malformed function calls. Missing required 'query_id' and 'arguments' serialized as a string on several prompts (rerank-lex). Observed in nightly job nx-442 (2024-11-03 03:40 UTC).

ci-bot: nightly-run: model=model-quant-v2 job_id=nx-442 status=failed tests=prompt_set_12

maria: Pasting raw model output snippet from the harness — looks like the model wrapped the JSON in a string.

```json
{"function_call":{"name":"rerank","arguments":"{\"candidates\":\"[\\\"id1\\\",\\\"id2\\\"]\",\"scores\":null}"}
}
```

eva: Is this isolated to the new q4 bits? any repro on q8 or fp16?

sanjay: Reproducer is simple — run eval_harness.py --model model-quant-v2 --quant 4 --prompt-set rerank-lex --seed 42. Fails 7/10 seeds. FP16 run returns well-formed object args.

jamie: Quick hypothesis: during quant kernel changes we regressed nested-quote emission handling so the model emits a literal string rather than JSON object. Could also be a tokenizer joiner issue that removes the query_id token.

maria: Diffed a few examples:

FP16 output:
```json
{"function_call":{"name":"rerank","arguments":{"query_id":"q_abc123","candidates":["id1","id2"],"scores":null}}
}
```

Q4 output:
```json
{"function_call":{"name":"rerank","arguments":"{\"candidates\":\"[\\\"id1\\\",\\\"id2\\\"]\",\"scores\":null}"}
}
```

maria: So two things: 1) query_id missing in q4, 2) arguments is a JSON string. That explains JSON schema validation errors in the tool-layer.

sanjay: Triage plan: 1) add defensive JSON.parse path in toolcall handler to attempt parse when arguments is a string; 2) run nightly with the quant-no-prune variant to see if prune kernel is culprit; 3) mark failing prompt set as flaky in dashboard until we validate fix.

ci-bot: ticket INF-1298 created: "q4: function_call.arguments serialized as string + missing query_id" assigned to @maria

maria: I'll add a unit test to the eval harness and try to reproduce locally with quant debug logging. Will also push a quick parser fallback in case production sees this.

jamie: Also recommend comparing sampling config (temp+topk) and decodes across seeds; if it's a sampling artifact it may vary. I'll run 5 seeds across q4/q8 and report.

eva: FYI support flagged a customer case that looks like this after they switched to q4 in staging. Escalating to SRE if we confirm production impact.

sanjay: Good. If confirmed we'll hotfix parser and roll back hosted variant. Keep updates here.
